name: effect-displace-wave
title: Displacement Wave
description: Chữ được cắt thành nhiều dải mỏng, mỗi dải lệch ngang theo một làn sóng chạy qua hai lượt, đầu và cuối đều thẳng hàng.

moworks.author: moworks

options.duration: s (2.2, linear): the crest crosses twice

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Element cut into 26 horizontal bands (recipe: 10). Band i shifts x by 16 px x sin(0.16 i - 4 pi tau) x sin^2(pi tau), tau 0 -> 1 linear over 2200 ms (recipe 1000 ms): the crest travels across the bands twice and the envelope is zero at both ends, so the outline is clean at start and end. Areas outside the band zone stay still. Params: bands (26) · amp (16 px) · duration (2.2 s). x = amp × sin(0.16 i − 4π τ) × sin²(π τ): clean at the start and at the end.
